label: Speech Bubble
description: What someone says, placed where they are: a rounded bubble with a tail pointing at the speaker (place the box beside the person or the avatar; tail says which side they are on). Sized from its box, hugging the text; words appear in reading order, or on word_times to sit on the voice. White over the camera or a dark ground, brand on a light ground.

name.label: Small name line above the text

tail.label: Where the speaker is: bottom-left (default) | bottom-right | top-left | top-right | left | right

theme.label: light | dark | brand (default: light over camera/dark ground, brand on a light ground)

word_times.label: Seconds each word appears (sync to the voice)

at.label: Seconds into the scene it enters (default 0.2)
